note: City of Starbuck campground beside the Starbuck Marina at the west end of Lake Minnewaska, on the Glacial Lakes Trail to the city beach and park. Boat slips can be rented by the day. Most lots are rented by the season. --Claude
summary: City page + 2021 map read: 102 RV sites (electric + water; F lots full hookup) + 2 tent; $38 electric / $53 full hookup; phone reservations; shower house, dump. DROP CANDIDATE: mostly seasonal (map marks only 16 of 102 RV lots for daily rental; old note said 55 seasonal). WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview proposed (daily lots 51E-54E on the treed lake edge; the open lakeside and channel-side lots are seasonal). Google 4.5 (87). Phone/website confirmed.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay, mostly seasonal): the city's campground map (dated 8.25.21, linked from the campground page) shades only 16 'Daily Rental Lots' of the 102 RV lots (18F, 71F, 38E, 46E, 47E, 51E, 52E, 53E, 54E, 55E, 58E, 59E, 64E, 66E, 67E, 69E), so ~84% of the RV lots are seasonal/long-term; imagery shows nearly every lot occupied by parked trailers in May. The 2026 rates post nightly, weekly, monthly ($810/$910) and seasonal ($2,640) prices. The stored note said 55 of 102 were seasonal; the current map says more. No wording on the page discourages nightly guests ('For reservations please call 320-239-2336'). Local (city) campground, no price gate. Google Maps 4.5 from 87 reviews. Reviewer decides; the note now says most lots are seasonal.

Waterfront: lakefront -> lakeview (downgrade). The lots nearest Lake Minnewaska are on the campground's east edge along Walleye Lane and Pike Lane. The daily-rental lots there, 51E-54E (about 45.6062-45.6066,-95.5255), run to the shore boundary, but on imagery that southern stretch of shore is a band of trees ~10-20 m wide between the pads and the water. The open lawn running to the shore with docks (about 45.6070,-95.5250) is in the seasonal lots (56E, 57E, 62E, 63E area). The lots along Marina Lane (8F, 9F, 42E, 43E) face the marina channel across the public marina road and slips and are seasonal. No nightly lot is shown on open ground at the water; lakeview is the call for the nightly sites. If the reviewer reads the 51E-54E tree band as thin, lakefront could stand with those four lots named.
Season: the current city page gives no dates (stored 05-01 to 09-30, derived from the old note, left unchanged).
Hookups: electric amperage not stated; F lots are the full-hookup sites (sewer).

Pin: stored 45.60806,-95.52906 is on the marina parking lot at the head of the boat basin (Google's pin is the same spot); the camp loops centre on about 45.6075,-95.5274, ~145 m away. Within tolerance; optional move.
Phone 320-239-2336 confirmed (reservations line; Google lists the same). Website https://starbuckmn.gov/hobo-park confirmed.
